text:
Maria Ortiz: Heads-up — I'm putting together a canary vs baseline dashboard prototype for the runtime rollout next Wednesday. Need quick input from runtime, API, console, analytics, and SRE. Primary goals: catch regressions (latency/cost/error/quality) within 15m and surface which inputs (model, sequence length, routing policy) caused them. Thoughts? :eyes:

Devon Park: +1. Key metrics from runtime side: p50/p90/p95 token-latency per-request, tokens/sec (per-GPU), batch size distribution, queue length, KV cache hit rate, prefix cache hit rate. Tag all of them with rollout_id and variant. Keep histograms for latencies.

Samir Patel: SRE notes: also need error counts by type (model-oom, model-crash, 5xx gateway, rate-limited). Windowed error-rate (1m/5m/1h) and a rolling unique user-impact metric. For canary we should sample 100% for traces and 100% metrics; baseline can be 1–5% sampling to save cost. Important: consistent rollout_id tag so we can join traces to metrics.

Jamie Chen: Console wants side-by-side comparison panels, a percent-diff heatmap, and an automatic "most-regressed requests" table where you can click into a trace and see the input prompt and tokens generated. Also need a simple UX for engineers to set the baseline window (last 24h / last 7d) and the canary window. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Kevin O'Rourke: From API/proxy: will add header passthrough for rollout info. Propose header: `X-Redwood-Rollout: canary-20260323-v2`. We'll also emit telemetry tags from the proxy so runtime sees the header in traces. One caveat: rate limiting and quotas must be enforced per rollout bucket — otherwise a canary could starve prod.

Jen Wu: Analytics proposals: compute these derived signals: 1) relative_latency_increase = (p95_canary - p95_prod)/p95_prod; 2) error_rate_delta = error_rate_canary - error_rate_prod; 3) throughput_per_gpu_delta; 4) token_cost_delta. We'll run a small A/B statistical test for error_rate (wald / bayesian) and surface p-values/confidence intervals in the dashboard. Alert if relative_latency_increase > 0.10 AND p95_prod > 200ms, or if error_rate_delta > 0.01.

Devon Park: Small note on GPU metrics — raw utilization is noisy; recommend normalized metric: tokens_generated / GPU-second to compare throughput efficiency across instance sizes. Also include quantization/precision tag (e.g., fp16/q4) since those change kernel execution.

Samir Patel: Operational: tagging scheme must be stable. Proposed tags: `rollout_id`, `variant` (canary|prod), `model`, `model_version`, `region`, `routing_policy`. We need to ensure cardinality stays low — model_version should be coarse (major.minor) not commit hash.

Kevin O'Rourke: Example proxy header + telemetry snippet for instrumentation:```
# HTTP header
X-Redwood-Rollout: canary-20260323-v2

# StatsD-style metric emit from proxy
timers.llm.request_latency:312|ms|#rollout:canary-20260323-v2,model:gpt4o,variant:canary
counters.llm.errors:1|c|#error:oom,rollout:canary-20260323-v2
```

Jamie Chen: For the console UX, can we show a small sparkline of the metric for baseline and canary, plus an inline percent-diff and a chevron (up/down) coloured by severity? Also add a button to "open failing traces" that filters by the same rollout_id.

Maria Ortiz: Agreed — UX pattern sounds good. We should also decide how long to keep canary metrics at full fidelity; propose 48h then downsample to 1m granularity.

Jen Wu: On alerting: we'll create two alert tiers — warning (automated slack notification to #eng-platform with aggregated diffs) and critical (pager to oncall) if error_rate_delta > 0.05 or any model_crash occurs > 3x baseline in 1h. Also we'll add a regression signal based on eval dataset prompt set (if available) to detect quality drops.

Devon Park: Implementation notes for runtime: need to add rollout_id to emitted metrics and spans as tags. Also expose per-request KV cache hit/miss counters. I'll open a runtime PR to add those tags and a small exporter change to include rollout labels in Prometheus.

Samir Patel: deploy-bot: "Deploy scheduled: canary rollout 'canary-20260323-v2' created by @Maria Ortiz — 10% traffic -> 50% after 30m if no alerts."

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: "Canary created — rollout_id=canary-20260323-v2, variant=canary, start=1719004321"

Maria Ortiz: Action items: Devon to open runtime PR for tags + KV metrics, Kevin to add header passthrough + sampling config, Jamie to prototype side-by-side dashboard mock, Jen to wire alerts and derived metrics, Samir to add SLO thresholds and oncall paging rules. I'll collect these into a short RFC today and post to #eng-platform for review. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

Kevin O'Rourke: FYI I'll also add a small rate-limit guard in the proxy for rollout buckets so a misconfigured canary can't take all capacity.

Jamie Chen: I'll include a toggle in the dashboard mock to switch baseline windows and annotate the canary start time on the graphs so diffs are obvious.

Maria Ortiz: Perfect — aim to sync tomorrow 10:30am to review the PRs and mock.
